story_zh: 我坐火车去南方。经过地铁站时，我看了地图。我有一辆自行车，但今天坐出租车。司机开车经过一栋楼，我们坐电梯上楼。我的护照在包里。明天飞机起飞，我要去坐船。
story_pinyin: Wǒ zuò huǒchē qù nánfāng. Jīngguò dìtiě zhàn shí, wǒ kànle dìtú. Wǒ yǒu yī liàng zìxíngchē, dàn jīntiān zuò chūzūchē. Sījī kāichē jīngguò yī dòng lóu, wǒmen zuò diàntī shàng lóu. Wǒ de hùzhào zài bāo lǐ. Míngtiān fēijī qǐfēi, wǒ yào qù zuò chuán.
story_en: I take a train to the south. When passing by the subway station, I look at the map. I have a bicycle, but today I take a taxi. The driver drives past a building, and we take the elevator upstairs. My passport is in my bag. Tomorrow the plane takes off, and I will go to take a boat.
